verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is marketing copy. It says Mixpanel's Agents "monitor your product continuously" and "surface insights before you think to ask". Related copy describes diagnosing what changed, delivered as a dashboard, with an example insight of "Signups dipped 19% last week". That loosely suggests proactive detection of metric changes, but nothing documents the actual mechanism. Missing for 10: documented dashboard subscriptions (scheduled email or Slack delivery), configurable metric alerts or anomaly-detection thresholds, notification channels, and any first-party docs or hands-on corroboration of alerting.
